title: user.verified
description: Published by auth-service (RabbitMQ auth.exchange, routing key user.verified) after email verification. Unlike every other event in this project, the payload is a bare JSON integer (the user's id) -- not an object -- because UserService.verifyEmail's Outbox row wraps only String.valueOf(user.getId()) as the envelope body. Consumed by products-service (role SELLER only) and orders-service.
